title: Собрать final evidence dossier и адъюдицировать residual risk
summary: Independently exact-join P1–P10 evidence into a final dossier and assign every residual one explicit owner, impact, disposition and release-axis consequence.
why: Aggregate PASS without residual ownership can hide baseline-pending timings, unavailable hosted capabilities, non-applicable MCP rows or accepted non-guarantees behind one green label. `RAG:—`.

include: Recompute P10.1 matrix over current bytes; final threat/guarantee/support/API/conformance/adversarial/supply-chain/doc/consumer coverage; residual-risk ledger; private/public blocker sets; accepted non-guarantees; capability and point-in-time evidence ages; exact subject/source/tree identity; deterministic dossier schema/renderer; independent corruption and omission checks.
exclude: Fixing product defects; changing contracts or acceptance thresholds; owner acceptance of legal/public risk; publishing; adding a second semantic audit; collapsing child evidence into a single score.

rules: Recompute rather than trust rendered summaries. Every residual row includes stable ID, originating evidence, affected subject/API, severity/impact, owner, disposition, private/public blocker booleans, expiry/review trigger and supporting digest. `accepted-non-guarantee` cannot hide a failed required guarantee. `baseline_pending`, `capability_unavailable`, scanner age and non-applicability stay visible. Private readiness is GREEN only with zero unresolved private blockers and all required evidence fresh. Public readiness is eligibility only, never authorization, and stays false while D5 or the MCP hosted topology is unresolved.
guidance: Treat all aggregate child receipts as untrusted inputs and validate schemas, digests, exact-set membership and source/tree coherence. Render tables from JSON. Mutate each relation in fixtures, including swapped subject hashes, stale source tree, omitted residual, promoted timing result, merged MCP percentage, false attestation and an owner-decision row silently marked accepted.
deliverables: Machine-readable final release dossier, rendered evidence report and complete residual-risk ledger with separate private-readiness and public-eligibility verdicts.

result.notes:
WPA-02 repair: rebuilt dossier has zero private blockers and 18 explicit public blockers; private GREEN, public RED, authorization false. Recovered terminal receipt with deterministic run identity.
